pages.text: A puppet show was in the middle of the market. The three rushed over.
Kiki really wanted to see it, but tall grown-ups stood in front.
Kiki rose high onto tiptoe. Not a puppet was visible.
Kiki covered their face with their tail. "I will not watch."
Nono and Gugu moved toward the front. Kiki stayed with that tail covering their face.
Laughter burst from the front. Kiki did not know what was funny.
Only then did Kiki lower the tail. Just an empty stage remained.
Grandpa Badger demonstrated tapping the shoulder of someone standing ahead.
The next day brought another puppet show. Kiki asked the person in front, "I cannot see. May I go ahead?"
People moved aside a little. Kiki watched the whole show from the front.
